page.title: Keep Tanzania's risk picture current
page.lead: Sector officers enter new indicator values with their source, PMO reviewers check and approve them, and approved values flow straight into every map, table and area profile.

mode.demoTitle: Demo mode: data stays in this browser
mode.demoLead: No shared database is connected, so everything you enter is saved only on this device and never leaves it. Switch role to walk through the whole workflow: submit as a sector officer, then approve as a PMO reviewer.

roleDesc.sector: Enter values and send them for PMO review.
roleDesc.pmo: Review the queue, approve, reject and revert. Your own entries apply immediately.
roleDesc.admin: Full access: everything a PMO reviewer can do.

mode.live: Connected to the shared national database
mode.profileErrorTitle: Your account could not be loaded
mode.profileErrorLead: You are signed in, but your INFORM profile was not found or could not be read. Ask a PMO administrator to check your account, or sign out and try again.

signIn.title: Sign in to contribute
signIn.lead: The portal is for government officers and partners who maintain INFORM data. Anyone can browse approved changes; contributing needs an account.
signIn.point1: Every value carries its authority, dataset and author.
signIn.point2: Nothing reaches the public map until a PMO reviewer approves it.
signIn.point3: Every submission, approval and revert is kept in an audit trail.
signIn.linkHint: We will email you a one-time link, so no password is needed. It brings you straight back here.
signIn.passwordHint: Use the password set up by your administrator.
signIn.linkSentLead: We sent a sign-in link to {{email}}. Open it on this device to continue.

access.title: Want to contribute data?
access.lead: Contributor access is for officers of ministries, agencies and local government who hold data for INFORM indicators. Approval by the PMO Disaster Management Department keeps the public map trustworthy.
access.step1Title: Sign in with your work email
access.step1: New accounts start with read-only access.
access.step2Title: Ask for the sector officer role
access.step2: Contact your PMO-DMD focal point with your institution and the indicators you hold.
access.step3: A PMO reviewer checks each submission before it reaches the map.
access.demoHint: In this demo, choose “Sector officer” or “PMO reviewer” above to try it.
access.signedInHint: Once your role is updated, reload this page to see the entry tools.
access.signedOutHint: Sign in above to get started.

states.errorLead: Check your connection and try again.

discard.title: Discard unsaved values?
discard.lead_one: You have {{count}} unsaved value for this council. Switching council will discard it.
discard.lead_other: You have {{count}} unsaved values for this council. Switching council will discard them.

scores.pickLead: Choose the council whose indicator scores you are updating.
scores.emptyLead: You will see all 32 indicators with their current values and sources, and a live preview of how your changes move the council’s risk.
scores.hint: Type a new 0–10 score next to any indicator. Leave it blank to keep the current value.
scores.pendingTip: You already sent a value for this indicator. It is waiting for a PMO reviewer.
scores.sharedTitle: Vulnerability and coping scores are stored on the INFORM source unit “{{source}}”
scores.sharedSiblings_one: The survey data behind them has no council breakdown, so a change to any of these rows also applies to {{names}}.
scores.sharedSiblings_other: The survey data behind them has no council breakdown, so a change to any of these rows also applies to {{names}}.
scores.sharedAlone: No other council uses this source unit, so a change to any of these rows affects only {{council}}.
scores.exposureFloodEdited: Your flood value takes precedence over exposure amplification.
scores.exposureDesc: Population exposure index (0–10) from council population and area. It amplifies the flood hazard as INFORM’s Hazard × Exposure term.
scores.noDataOn: Marked as no data. Click to undo.
scores.noDataOff: Mark as no data (left out of averages, not zero)

errors.decimals: Use at most one decimal, for example 6.5.

preview.idle: Change a value to see how the council’s scores would move.
preview.pending_one: What the map would show after approving {{count}} change.
preview.pending_other: What the map would show after approving {{count}} changes.
preview.srSummary: {{name}}: INFORM Risk would change from {{before}} to {{after}}.
preview.classUp: This council would move into a higher risk class.
preview.classDown: This council would move into a lower risk class.
preview.barLegend: Bars show the value after approval; the thin mark shows today’s value.
preview.siblingsTitle_one: Also changes {{count}} council sharing the source unit
preview.siblingsTitle_other: Also changes {{count}} councils sharing the source unit

submit.title: Source and submission
submit.leadSector: Say where the values come from. A PMO reviewer checks them before they reach the map.
submit.leadReviewer: As a reviewer, your changes apply immediately and are recorded as self-approved.
submit.splitLead: Hazard values belong to the council; vulnerability and coping values belong to its shared INFORM source unit. Each is reviewed on its own.
submit.appliedToast_other: {{count}} submissions applied. The map is updated.

confirm.title: Check before you submit
confirm.leadSector: These go to the PMO review queue. Nothing changes on the map until they are approved.
confirm.leadReviewer: As a reviewer, these changes are applied to the map immediately.
confirm.appliesTo: Applies to every council sharing this source unit: {{names}}

meta.authoritySuggested: Suggested from the indicator’s usual source. Change it if needed.
meta.notePlaceholder: What changed and why? Mention the survey round, period or method.
meta.noteHint: A short note helps the reviewer approve faster.
meta.noteRequired: Required: these changes lower the council’s risk by more than 1 point.

errors.note_required: Please explain this reduction for the reviewer.

raw.pickLead: Choose the council the measured values describe.
raw.emptyLead: You will see the 53 workbook indicators with their units and reference ranges; each value is standardised to 0–10 as you type.
raw.introTitle: Enter what you measured, in its own unit
raw.introLead: For example 18 for 18 % underweight children. The INFORM workbook method turns each value into a 0–10 score; the indicators you fill are averaged into their component, which updates the matching model indicator.
raw.sharedTarget_one: stored on the source unit (also {{count}} other council)
raw.sharedTarget_other: stored on the source unit (also {{count}} other councils)

paste.setupLead: One indicator at a time, for many councils or regions at once, straight from a spreadsheet.

levelHelp.council: One line per council. Values without names are matched in template order.
levelHelp.region: One line per region. The value applies to every council in it.
levelHelp.nation: One value for the whole country, applied to every council.

paste.targetCouncil: Hazard values are stored on each council.
paste.targetShared: Vulnerability and coping values are stored on INFORM source units: councils sharing one are merged, so their values must agree.

placeholder.council:
Kondoa District	6.5
Kondoa Town	6.1
Mpwapwa District	5.8

paste.help: Separate name and value with a tab, comma, semicolon or |. Decimal commas (6,5) work. Write “n/a” for no data.
paste.emptyLead: Matching, issues and the effect on risk classes appear here before anything is submitted.
paste.impactClasses: {{up}} would move to a higher risk class and {{down}} to a lower one.
paste.positional: No names found, so the values were matched to the first {{count}} in template order ({{level}}). Check the preview carefully.

issues.notNumber: The value is not a number.
issues.ambiguous: Matches several councils: {{candidates}}. Add District, Town, Municipal or City.
issues.missingName: A name is missing on this line.
issues.duplicate: {{suggestion}} appears more than once. The last value is used.
issues.extraValue: Only the first value is used at national level.
issues.tooManyValues: More values than units in the template.
issues.noDataNotAllowed: Exposure cannot be marked as no data.

paste.leadSector: Each unit becomes its own submission in the PMO review queue.
paste.leadReviewer: As a reviewer, your values are applied to the map immediately, one submission per unit.
paste.noteHint: One note is attached to every submission in this batch.
paste.partialToast: {{ok}} saved, {{failed}} failed. See the list below.
paste.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Use the CSV template instead.

review.emptyLead: No submissions are waiting for review. New ones will appear here.
review.reasonRequired: Reason for rejecting (the author will see it)
review.notePlaceholder: e.g. Please attach the survey table for this round…
review.approvedToast: Approved. {{name}} is updated on the map.
review.rejectedToast: Rejected {{name}}. The author will see your reason.
review.bulkApproveLead: Each approval is applied to the map and recorded in the audit trail.
review.bulkRejectLead: The authors will see your reason.

mine.emptyLead: Values you send for review appear here with their status and the reviewer’s feedback.

approved.emptyTitle: The official baseline is in use
approved.emptyLead: No approved changes yet. Every map shows the INFORM Sub-national SADC 2024 values.
approved.revertLead: {{indicator}} for {{unit}} will go back to the official baseline value. The revert is logged.
approved.revertedToast: {{indicator}} for {{unit}} is back to the baseline

activity.emptyLead: Submissions, approvals, rejections and reverts are recorded here.

tools.importLead: Values in the file are re-submitted as pending submissions for review. Nothing is applied directly.
tools.planLead: {{unchanged}} values that already match the current data are skipped.

issueKinds.unsupportedUnit: only councils and INFORM source units can be edited

tools.imported_one: {{count}} submission added to the review queue
tools.imported_other: {{count}} submissions added to the review queue

errors.json: This is not a valid JSON file.
errors.format: This file is not an INFORM Tanzania export.
errors.version: This export comes from an unsupported version.
errors.read: The file could not be read.

tools.resetLead: Clears the approved values, submissions and activity stored in this browser.
tools.resetWarn: Export a JSON copy first if you might need this data again. The shared database is not affected.
tools.resetAck: I understand: delete the data in this browser
tools.resetDone: Local data cleared. The official baseline is back.
